(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (cellmap g
                    (r c v)
                    (let* ((pair-start (- c (remainder c 2)))
                           (offset (remainder c 2))
                           (old-pair (- (- w 2) pair-start))
                           (old-c (+ old-pair offset)))
                      (at g r old-c))))))

                           (old-c (+ old-pair offset)))
                      (at g r old-c))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ([w (cols g)])
    (cellmap g
             (r c v)
             (let* ([tile-start (- c (remainder c 3))]
                    [offset (remainder c 3)]
                    [source-start (- (- w 3) tile-start)])
               (at g r (+ source-start offset)))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ([w (cols g)])
    (cellmap g
             (r c v)
             (let* ([tile-start (- c (remainder c 3))]
                    [offset (remainder c 3)]
                    [source-start (- (- w 3) tile-start)])
               (at g r (+ source-start offset)))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ([h (rows g)] [w (cols g)] [k 2] [n (quotient w k)]
         [scores (for/list ([s (in-range 0 w k)]) (for*/sum ([r (in-range h)] [c (in-range s (+ s k))]) (if (zero? (at g r c)) 0 1)))]
         [p (for/fold ([best 0]) ([i (in-range 1 n)]) (if (> (list-ref scores i) (list-ref scores best)) i best))])
    (cellmap g (r c v)
      (let* ([j (quotient c k)] [offset (remainder c k)] [source (if (<= j p) (- p j) j)])
        (at g r (+ (* source k) offset)))))))
